Q: How to reset ContentControl.Color to default? A:

The starting point here IMO is that in the Word object model there is a value called "wdColorAutomatic", which, if you could apply it, would do what you wanted, i.e. reset the contentcontrol.color to the "default". And just to be sure, that's actually the colour used for the box surrounding the content control, not the text colour or the background colour.

And AIUI the named colours are "web colour names" such as "red" etc.

But , although the documentation at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/word.wdcolor says the hex value equivalent to wdColorAutomatic is "#000000#, it also says the decimal value is -16777216, i.e. hex FF000000. And if you try to pass "#FF000000" in JS, it will fail. And the other obvious possibility, passing "" also fails, as does "auto". And TBH, unless the officejs implementation can pass something equivalent to "FF000000" to the underlying Word engine, it's not going to do a "reset".

I've seen that it might be possible to pass some colour names that are not web colour names, e.g. theme colour names such as "dark1" or "light1". But I can't see that that would work in the general case either.

If that is all correct, I can only assume that either the Microsoft team implementing Office-JS just didn't cover the ground, which seems unlikely but I suppose is possible, or they had a good reason (either technical , or perhaps "web-oriented") not to allow it. But might be worth asking (is "office-js" the right tag?) just to check.

Q: List all virtualenv created by virtualenvwrapper A:

For those people like me that "command not found: lsvirtualenv"
It works great.

find ~ -name "pyvenv.cfg" 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do
  dir=$(dirname "$f")
  ver=$(grep -m1 "version" "$f")
  echo "$dir  ->  $ver"
done

Q: How can i connect to salesforce api to pull data into Snowflake A:

It is definitely possible to write and run a python script to pull data. But if this is a requirement that has movement of more than 100k rows or grow to it and more, I highly recommend you look at an ETL tool option.
Maintaining the pipeline is an absolute headache! I will recommend looking for something thats fully managed and provides a free tier like hevo or skyvia, so you can test it out before committing.

Q: Adding external images to PDF using iText A:

Q: Costs for setting up data integration tool for Salesforce A:

I think you should check Hevo Data. it has a native Salesforce connector (and connectors for most common back-office systems: ERPs, databases, other SaaS apps), so it handles the integration/sync piece without custom code.

On cost: Hevo's managed plans has a free tier you can check out. Handles i think upto 1M events (their version of MAR). There no other setup cost and training is easy as it is point and click. Worth checking out.
